name: James: Masquerade Ball
source:
When James asks you to an elegant masquerade, your perfect night is threatened by a girl from his past! Who's behind the mask?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/James:_Masquerade_Ball]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当詹姆斯邀请你参加一场优雅的化装舞会时，你的完美夜晚受到了他过去的一个女孩的威胁！面具后面是谁？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/James:_Masquerade_Ball]Choices Wikia[/url]]
